disease_label_per_paper: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia with severe hypercalcemia in an immunosuppressed renal transplant patient
presentation_summary: Two weeks of shortness of breath, chest tightness, night sweats, polyuria, polydipsia, musculoskeletal pain, and constipation.
History included renal transplant, chronic graft dysfunction, native nephrectomies for renal cell carcinoma, and maintenance prednisolone plus mycophenolate.
Exam was afebrile, normotensive, not tachycardic, but SpO2 was 92-93% on room air; she later developed tachypnea, crepitations, and increasing oxygen requirement.
Labs showed creatinine 296 umol/L, CRP 23 mg/L, relative lymphopenia, and severe hypercalcemia; chest X-ray showed bilateral patchy lower-lobe consolidation.
